reviews.title: Good, almost great.
reviews.text:
Pros:
- Simple, focused, easy to use (has none of the useless fluff that many other macro counting apps have). 
- Large food database (better accuracy in Europe)

Cons:
- Food database in USA is largely inaccurate. Most barcodes I’ve scanned have given inaccurate results. Usually you can find the correct entry after scrolling through the many results for the same food, but 30% of the time I’ve had to replace the barcode entry with the correct amounts.
- You always have to compare the calorie breakdown of the search results with the nutritional label on the food as most of the time it’s incorrect in the database. 
- When adding a food, the results on the All tab is not sorted by most recently used. This is a pain in the a**!! It makes food entry much slower than it needs to be. 
- When creating a Meal, it doesn’t prompt you when going back to the previous screen before you have finished adding the ingredients. And when you go back, you have to start again from scratch. 
- You cannot move multiple foods to a different Meal time all at once (it can only be done one at a time)

Suggested Improvements:
- Display a mini macro breakdown next to each meal (in addition to the calorie amounts)
- When adding a food, have the foods displayed in the All tab sorted by most recently used. 
- Add a “Favorite Foods” tab and allow us to mark frequently eaten foods as favorites. This would really help to offset the poor quality of the food database results in the USA. 
- Add a prompt (“Do you want to cancel the creation of this Meal?”) when going back a screen when you have started to create a meal and have added 1 or more foods to the Meal. 
- Allow moving multiple foods at once to a different meal time.
